construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

County file PLN24-020 covers Building Site Approval, Grading Approval and Planning Clearance for a new single-family residence and ADU, "development of five (5) new and conversion of the existing residence to a total of six (5) agriculture worker housing units," and a small-scale winery with wine tasting on a 7.38-acre lot. The letter gives both six and five as the agriculture worker unit total.

The county letter notes Santa Teresa Blvd is a designated scenic road, so structures within 100 feet of the right of way are subject to design review, and records a historic resource on the site (P-43-002845).
The county letter is dated February 29, 2024; the state APR reports the application date as October 10, 2025.
